Getting started

Ferrite is an embedded time-series database. This page installs it and runs a first query against sample data.

Install

Add the crate to your project, then open a database file. Ferrite creates the file on first use and keeps one write-ahead log next to it.

First query

Insert a few points and ask for the hourly average. Queries return an iterator, so large ranges never load into memory at once.

Next, read about retention policies.
